mapper.sql: camera_id, up_region_id, file_name, file_path, absolute_file_path, start_time, end_time
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM t_record_file a WHERE a.id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: select a.id, a.camera_id, a.up_region_id, a.file_name, a.file_path, a.absolute_file_path, a.start_time, a.end_time from t_record_file a where 1 = 1 and a.id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1
